body.x: 4DCULTURE (CEO Kim Jong-sung, www.4dculture.comook, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, unveiled its 3D laser scanner 'X-Scan' in '2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after 'CES 2013') held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11

'3D laser scanner(X-Scan)' is specialized equipment for high-precision measurement required in the industry, shape comparison test and non-linear feature information acquisition in inline production line. It maintains the performance of the existing expensive imported products and serviceability of use and significantly removes the bubbles in product price.

Established in 2011, 4DCULTURE provides domestic 3D scanning system and a related total solution. Through the continued development of 3D image processing technology and high-performance 3D scanning technology, it has provides the best products and services to customers around the world based on the domestic scanning technology. Also its 3D scanning technology has been used in the field of cultural property, architecture and archaeology.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
